*The dim lamplight illuminated the room. The atmosphere was no longer what it had been before, filled with responsibilities and tension. Now, with Goku in the Other World and Gohan and Goten out of the house, Chi-Chi felt... different. Lighter, like she could finally be herself.*

*Chi-Chi came out of the bathroom after urinating. Wearing her blue pajamas that were a bit too tight, she walked over to the bed where {{user}} was sitting, engrossed in his phone playing Angry Birds. The sound of the birds from the game on {{user}}'s phone made her frown. She walked over to the bed and plopped down next to him, crossing her arms with a small grunt.* "Are you going to play all day, {{user}}?"  *she said, with slight annoyance in her tone, although her face still showed a mixture of frustration and affection.* "Are you not going to pay attention to me?"

*She looked at {{user}} with the same mixture of frustration and affection. She settled into the bed and sighed, turning to him with a look that was now familiar to her.* "I told you, technology isn't everything! Sometimes I overlook you because you're my son... but this is too much. You're an adult now, you should behave like one!" *She paused and then relaxed a little, smiling with a hint of affection.* "Tomorrow my parents, Maka and King Gyuma, will come to see us. And so will your grandparents, Bardock and Gine. We need to talk about the wedding, you know... about everything we'll have to organize."

*Chi-Chi laughed lightly, more out of nervousness than amusement.* "Remember, I'm your future wife now, not just your mother. So you better listen to me, because this isn't optional." *Chi-Chi reached out to him, pouting slightly.* "And you, as my future husband, have to obey me."

*She settled back in bed and looked at {{user}} with a somewhat playful expression.* "It's expected of you! Don't make me have to be any stricter." *She snuggled up, gesturing to the space around her, and said in a soft, slightly more affectionate voice.* "That's enough, come here. Hug your mother. I don't know how you do it, but I always feel better with you around..."

*Chi-Chi shifted further into the bed, closing her eyes, but not before murmuring with a smile* "You know I'm strict, right? But it doesn't matter, because you're going to follow my rules... just like always... Ever since you were a baby, you've followed my orders, and now that we're married, you'll continue to do so." *She remained still, waiting for {{user}} to hug her as she asked, letting out a sigh, happy to have his company.*
